models.title: v3 (baseline)
models.summary: Small YOLO model: 3,006,038 parameters, input 960 px. It is the baseline and the default, and has never been replaced. The ONNX export is the file the detector runs.
caveats: The ledger does not list what v3 was trained on.
v3 was probably trained on the Roboflow collection, so Roboflow scores flatter it (S4).

models.title: run1 (fine-tune)
models.summary: Fine-tune of v3 on Roboflow and Bird vs Drone pictures. The "auto" optimizer ignored the learning rate setting and used AdamW lr 0.001667. Not promoted.
caveats: Optimizer "auto" ignored the learning rate setting, so the run did not use the rate that was set.

models.title: run2 (fine-tune)
models.summary: Same data as run1, from notebook v10, with an intended AdamW lr 0.0005. Not promoted.
caveats: The optimizer line was not checked, so the learning rate actually used is not confirmed.

models.title: run3 (fine-tune)
models.summary: Same data and settings name as run2 (ft_lr0.0005_freeze10). Weights ft_best.pt 6.31 MB, ONNX 12.5 MB, exported as varn-ft-2026-10-28. Not promoted after the clip check.
caveats: It was a promote-candidate on the test-picture sets and was not promoted after the clip check (S5).

models.title: run4 (fine-tune)
models.summary: Fine-tune on Roboflow plus 3,000 Svanstrom training frames (public domain), split by whole video. Not promoted.
caveats: Its Svanstrom test frames come from the same drones and sites as training (S4).

models.title: run5 (fine-tune)
models.summary: Same as run4 with a train, validation and test split by video. Training stopped early after 38 of 126 planned epochs. Not promoted.
caveats: Its Svanstrom test frames come from the same drones and sites as training (S4).

experiments.title: Score v3 (no fine-tune)
experiments.summary: v3 scored as the baseline: the .pt and ONNX files on T-roboflow-800, and v3 on T-bvd-847.
caveats: Limit: v3 was probably trained on this collection, so it flatters v3.
The ledger does not say which v3 file produced the T-bvd-847 scores.

experiments.title: run1: scored on pictures
experiments.summary: run1 scored on T-roboflow-800 and T-bvd-847.
caveats: Limit: same collection as the training pictures. (T-bvd-847)
The ledger lists no real-clip result for run1.

experiments.title: run2: scored on pictures
experiments.summary: run2 scored on T-roboflow-800 and T-bvd-847.
caveats: The optimizer line was not checked (S2).
The ledger lists no real-clip result for run2.

experiments.title: run3: scored on pictures
experiments.summary: run3 scored on T-roboflow-800 and T-bvd-847. It was not promoted after the clip check (see the real-clip records).
experiments.verdict: promote-candidate, then KEEP v3 after the clip check.
caveats: Limit: same collection as the training pictures. (T-bvd-847)

experiments.title: run4: scored on pictures and held-out frames
experiments.summary: run4 scored on T-roboflow-800 and, beside v3, on T-svan-1195.
caveats: Limit: same drones and sites as training. (T-svan-1195)

experiments.title: run5: scored on pictures and held-out frames
experiments.summary: run5 scored on T-roboflow-800 and, beside v3, on T-svan-897. This is a different split from run4's T-svan-1195.
caveats: Limit: same drones and sites as training. (T-svan-897)
T-svan-897 and T-svan-1195 are different test sets, so run4 and run5 Svanstrom scores are not comparable.

experiments.title: Real-clip check: v3 against run3, run4, run5
experiments.summary: v3 compared with run3, run4 and run5 on the real clips, as a share of frames at confidence 0.35.
caveats: Wrong-class numbers count a wrong-class box anywhere in the frame, even when the right class also appears.
42 clips with per-video labels is a small test.

experiments.title: Real-clip check: run5 by clip group
experiments.summary: v3 and run5 compared inside each clip group of the real clips, at confidence 0.35.
caveats: Each group is its own test set; numbers are not comparable across groups.
Labels are per video, so frames where the object is out of view or tiny count as misses.

experiments.title: Threshold check: v3 against the run3 weights
experiments.summary: v3 and the run3 weights compared on the real clips at thresholds 0.25, 0.35, 0.5, 0.65 and 0.8, as a share of frames.
caveats: The rough score is a guide, not a verdict.
Lowest threshold tested was 0.25.

datasets.title: Roboflow airplane-drone-helicopter v2
datasets.summary: Roboflow set "airplane-drone-helicopter" v2. Of 4,045 validation pictures, 2,426 (60%) were near-copies of training pictures and were dropped, leaving 800 clean pictures for validation. 4,000 pictures were sampled for training.
caveats: License: not checked (S9).

datasets.title: Bird vs Drone
datasets.summary: Bird vs Drone (Kaggle), MIT license. 18,323 training pictures, 3,000 sampled. Pictures named DT are drones and BT are birds; birds are used as "no drone" examples.
caveats: No aircraft labels.
Test pictures come from the same collection as the training pictures.

datasets.title: Svanstrom drone-detection dataset
datasets.summary: Drone-detection-dataset (Svanstrom, Alonso-Fernandez, Englund 2021, "A Dataset for Multi-Sensor Drone Detection"), CC0 public domain. 650 videos labeled Airplane, Bird, Drone or Helicopter, with per-frame boxes. Only the visible videos were used.

attributes.label: Used
attributes.value: Only the visible videos were used

attributes.label: Credit
attributes.value: Svanstrom, Alonso-Fernandez, Englund (2021), "A Dataset for Multi-Sensor Drone Detection", Data in Brief

caveats: Daylight only; drones flown within 200 m.
Helicopters were treated as aircraft; bird frames as "nothing here".

datasets.title: Licensed real clips
datasets.summary: 43 licensed real clips (public domain and CC). One drone clip (drone_11) is a broken file and is skipped, leaving 42 clips and 1,701 frames at one frame per second.

attributes.label: Readable
attributes.value: 42 clips and 1,701 frames at one frame per second

caveats: Sources are kept in a private SOURCES_and_LICENSES.csv, which is not in this repository.
Labels are per video (the clip name), so frames where the object is out of view or tiny count as misses.

gaps.summary: No run on Varn's own camera in a real sky.

gaps.title: Empty-sky false alarms not measured
gaps.summary: False alarms on empty sky have not been measured.

gaps.title: v3 finds a drone in few real-clip frames
gaps.summary: v3 finds a drone in only about 8% of frames of the real drone clips.

gaps.title: v3 is nearly blind on small, distant objects
gaps.summary: v3 is nearly blind on small, distant objects (0.063 to 0.079 on held-out Svanstrom videos).

gaps.title: Fine-tunes mixed up drone and aircraft more
gaps.summary: Three kinds of fine-tune found aircraft in more frames but mixed up drone and aircraft more. v3 stays the default.

gaps.title: Unverified hypothesis: large military unmanned aircraft
gaps.summary: Hypothesis, NOT verified: large military unmanned aircraft are called "aircraft" because the training drones were small multirotors.

gaps.title: The real-clip test is small
gaps.summary: 42 clips with per-video labels is a small test. A hand-labeled set of boxes from real footage is needed.

notes.text: Varn is detection only: a camera finds objects in the sky and labels them drone or aircraft. No jamming or interference.
All numbers were copied by hand from Kaggle report.md files, run logs and a threshold-check notebook, Oct 2026.
No model has been run on Varn's own camera in a real sky. No hardware has been built. No empty-sky false-alarm rate has been measured.
metric "mAP50" = mean average precision at IoU 0.5, as reported by the Ultralytics validator.
